cards.example_en: The empty alley looked frightening after the street lights went out.
cards.example_zh: 路灯熄灭后，空荡荡的小巷看起来令人害怕。

cards.example_en: Dad will frown if you leave dirty plates in the sink.
cards.example_zh: 如果你把脏盘子留在水槽里，爸爸会皱眉。

cards.example_en: After running through the rain, the cat's fur was soaked.
cards.example_zh: 在雨里跑过之后，猫身上的软毛湿透了。

cards.example_en: The hotel is cheap; furthermore, it is close to the station.
cards.example_zh: 这家旅馆便宜；此外，它离车站很近。

cards.example_en: He shouted in fury when someone broke his new skateboard.
cards.example_zh: 有人弄坏他的新滑板时，他暴怒地大喊起来。

cards.example_en: Mum was furious because I came home two hours late.
cards.example_zh: 我晚了两个小时才回家，妈妈气坏了。

cards.example_en: Please do not make a fuss about a small stain on your shirt.
cards.example_zh: 衬衫上只有一小块污渍，请别大惊小怪。

cards.example_en: Bikes and a spare tyre fill the garage behind the house.
cards.example_zh: 自行车和一只备用轮胎塞满了屋后的车库。

cards.example_en: Runners gasp for air after the long race around the track.
cards.example_zh: 绕着跑道长跑结束后，选手们大口喘气。

cards.example_en: She gently placed the goldfish back into the bowl.
cards.example_zh: 她轻轻地把金鱼放回了鱼缸。

cards.example_en: With one gesture, the coach sent the substitute onto the field.
cards.example_zh: 教练做了一个手势，让替补队员上了场。

cards.example_en: Some children say a ghost lives in the old school building.
cards.example_zh: 有些孩子说老教学楼里住着一个鬼。

cards.example_en: The giant statue in the square is taller than our school building.
cards.example_zh: 广场上那座巨大的雕像比我们的教学楼还高。

cards.example_en: Yellow ginkgo leaves cover the pavement outside our school in autumn.
cards.example_zh: 秋天，学校外面的人行道铺满了黄色的银杏叶。

cards.example_en: She took a quick glance at the clock and ran for the bus.
cards.example_zh: 她迅速瞥了一眼时钟，然后跑去赶公交。

cards.example_en: Glutinous rice dumplings are a traditional food at the Dragon Boat Festival.
cards.example_zh: 糯米粽是端午节的传统食物。

cards.example_en: Golden sunlight filled the playground just before the bell rang.
cards.example_zh: 铃声响起前，金色的阳光洒满了操场。

cards.example_en: My goldfish swims in circles whenever I tap the glass.
cards.example_zh: 我一敲玻璃，金鱼就转着圈游。

cards.example_en: A goose chased us away from the pond in the park.
cards.example_zh: 公园池塘边，一只鹅把我们赶走了。

cards.example_en: The gorilla sat quietly and watched the children outside the glass.
cards.example_zh: 大猩猩安静地坐着，看着玻璃外面的孩子。

cards.example_en: The dancer looked graceful as she moved across the stage.
cards.example_zh: 舞者穿过舞台时，姿态看起来很优美。

cards.example_en: Every grandchild received a red envelope during the family dinner.
cards.example_zh: 家庭晚宴上，每个孙辈都收到了一个红包。

cards.example_en: Grandma packed dumplings for our early train this morning.
cards.example_zh: 奶奶今天早上为我们的早班火车包了饺子。

cards.example_en: Grandpa walks in the park every morning before breakfast.
cards.example_zh: 爷爷每天早饭前都在公园里散步。

cards.example_en: My granny taught me how to sew a button onto a shirt.
cards.example_zh: 外婆教我怎样把纽扣缝到衬衫上。

cards.example_en: Draw a graph to show how the temperature changed this week.
cards.example_zh: 画一张图表，显示这周气温是怎样变化的。

cards.example_en: Grate some cheese over the pasta before you serve it.
cards.example_zh: 上桌之前，在意大利面上磨一些奶酪。

cards.example_en: She expressed her gratitude by writing a card to the coach.
cards.example_zh: 她给教练写了一张卡片，以此来表达感激。

cards.example_en: Copy the numbers into the grid before you start the puzzle.
cards.example_zh: 开始做谜题之前，先把数字抄进网格里。

cards.example_en: He could not hide a grin when his team scored the winner.
cards.example_zh: 球队打进制胜球时，他忍不住咧嘴一笑。

cards.example_en: I cannot find my hairbrush, so my hair is a mess today.
cards.example_zh: 我找不到发刷，所以今天头发乱糟糟的。

cards.example_en: She changed her hairstyle before the school photo last week.
cards.example_zh: 上周学校拍照之前，她换了发型。

cards.example_en: During the drill, the officer locked one handcuff around the chair leg.
cards.example_zh: 演练时，警官把一只手铐锁在了椅腿上。

cards.example_en: I prefer a handwritten card to a message sent on the phone.
cards.example_zh: 比起手机上发来的消息，我更喜欢手写的卡片。

cards.example_en: Fishing boats returned to the harbour before the storm arrived.
cards.example_zh: 暴风雨到来之前，渔船返回了港口。

cards.example_en: Harry forgot his sports shoes and had to borrow a pair.
cards.example_zh: 哈里忘了带运动鞋，只好借了一双。

cards.example_en: A hawker sold grilled corn outside the stadium after the match.
cards.example_zh: 比赛结束后，一名小贩在体育场外卖烤玉米。

cards.example_en: Grandma told us kind people go to heaven after they die.
cards.example_zh: 奶奶告诉我们，善良的人死后会上天堂。

cards.example_en: A helicopter flew low over the beach during the rescue drill.
cards.example_zh: 救援演练时，一架直升机低低地飞过海滩。

cards.example_en: Without hesitation, she jumped into the pool to help her friend.
cards.example_zh: 她毫不犹豫地跳进泳池去帮朋友。

cards.example_en: A new high-rise beside the station has shops on the ground floor.
cards.example_zh: 车站旁的一座新高层建筑，底层有商店。

cards.example_en: Falling off his bicycle, my brother hurt his left hip badly.
cards.example_zh: 弟弟从自行车上摔下来，把左边的臀部摔伤了。

cards.example_en: Near the river, a huge hippo stood still and opened its wide mouth.
cards.example_zh: 在河边，一头巨大的河马静静站着，张开了大嘴。

cards.example_en: After school we play hockey on the field behind the gym.
cards.example_zh: 放学后，我们在体育馆后面的场地上打曲棍球。

cards.example_en: With a short speech, the students paid homage to the old scientist.
cards.example_zh: 学生们发表简短讲话，向那位老科学家致敬。

cards.example_en: Hooray, our class won the city basketball match this afternoon.
cards.example_zh: 好哇，我们班今天下午赢了全市篮球赛。

cards.example_en: When the bell rings, the children hop across the playground together.
cards.example_zh: 铃一响，孩子们就一起单脚跳着穿过操场。

cards.example_en: Dad bought me a hotdog and a cold drink at the stadium.
cards.example_zh: 爸爸在体育场给我买了一个热狗和一杯冷饮。

cards.example_en: After heavy rain, the air felt humid all over the city.
cards.example_zh: 大雨过后，全城的空气都感觉很潮湿。

cards.example_en: In the story, a family builds an igloo from blocks of snow.
cards.example_zh: 故事里，一家人用雪块搭了一座冰屋。

word.example_en: She took a glance at the station clock.
